meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能操作 DNAnexus 云平台：创建和部署应用（apps/applets）、上传下载数据文件、用 dxpy 编写脚本、运行与监控分析作业和工作流，并处理 FASTQ/BAM/VCF 等生物信息学文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或修改 DNAnexus 应用、上传或下载数据文件、运行或监控基因组学工作流等任务时触发。

say.note: 会调用上传函数并返回文件ID

say.text: 帮我创建一个applet，输入BAM文件，输出VCF
监控作业job-xxxx的状态，完成后下载结果
say.note: 会轮询状态并下载输出文件

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can operate DNAnexus cloud genomics: create and deploy apps/applets, upload/download data files, write dxpy scripts, run and monitor jobs and workflows, and handle FASTQ/BAM/VCF files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or modify DNAnexus apps, upload or download data files, run or monitor genomics workflows, and similar tasks.

say_en.text: Upload sample.fastq to project project-xxxx using dxpy.
say_en.note: Calls the upload function and returns file ID.

say_en.text: Create an applet that takes a BAM file and outputs a VCF.
say_en.note: Generates app code and dxapp.json config.

say_en.text: Monitor job job-xxxx and download the result when done.
say_en.note: Polls status and downloads the output file.
